run_publisher_server: run the Quart websocket server on port 5000 to stream observation frames via gripper-feed-ws
create_ObservationDirectoryWatcher: create an ObservationDirectoryWatcher instance to watch a directory for new observations and encode RGB tensors to JPEG
use_add_obs_callback: use the add_obs callback to process new observations and encode RGB data as JPEG bytes
stream_gripper_feed_websocket: stream base64-encoded JPEG frames over the gripper-feed-ws WebSocket endpoint at 5 FPS
configure_watcher_loop_mode: configure the ObservationDirectoryWatcher with loop mode to reset observation numbering when no new observations arrive
